Command.Name: graphics
Command.Title: Graphics Mod Recommendations.
Command.Description:
There are lots of graphics mods to choose from for GTA V. Below we have listed our own recommendations for maximum stability and compatibility with LSPDFR. 

 1. [CoreFX (Free)](https://www.patreon.com/c/crxhvrd/home) 

 2. [Visual V (Free)](https://www.gta5-mods.com/misc/visualv) 

3. [QuantV (Paid)](https://www.patreon.com/c/QuantV/home) 

 ### https://cdn.discordapp.com/emojis/795009091918626857.webp?size=96&animated=true Graphics Mods We Do Not Recommend 

 Natural Vision Evolved & Natural Vision Remastered - Whilst these both seem like great graphic enhancement mods, they constantly cause crashes, performance problems and compatibillity issues with LSPDFR.
